sources.title: CEMAC: Member States
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: The official CEMAC Commission site identifies its six current Member States, including the Central African Republic and the five mapped foreign member states.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cameroun, le Congo, le Gabon, la Guinée Équatoriale, la République de Centrafrique et le Tchad.

sources.title: CEMAC Commission President interview on free movement
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official CEMAC Commission publication quotes its President that visa-free movement for Member-State citizens is effective.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La libre circulation des citoyens des pays membres de la CEMAC, sans visa, est une réalité indéniable.

sources.title: Common Convention on free movement and right of establishment
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: CEMAC publishes the Common Convention in its official legal archive; its tourist free-movement provisions specify the travel-document and three-month terms for Member-State nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La libre circulation de ces personnes comporte le droit de se déplacer et de séjourner ... pendant une durée de 3 mois.

sources.title: Embassy of the Central African Republic in France: short-stay visa workflow
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Central African Republic in France
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Paris mission page is on the Central African Foreign Ministry official diplomatie.gouv.cf subdomain and describes the embassy short-stay visa processing workflow.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Joignez ensuite votre passeport et envoyez le tout à l'adresse de l'ambassade pour le traitement.

sources.title: Central African Republic International Travel Information
sources.officialityEvidence: Current State Department travel information specifically identifies the ordinary U.S.-passport tourist visa requirement and timing.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is required. You must apply for a visa before you travel.

sources.title: FCDO Central African Republic entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: Current FCDO entry guidance applies to full British citizen passports and directs visa application through the CAR Paris Embassy.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You will need a visa to enter the Central African Republic.

sources.title: German Foreign Office: Central African Republic travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: Current German Foreign Office entry guidance specifies that German nationals need a visa before travel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Deutsche Staatsangehörige benötigen für die Einreise ein Visum.

sources.title: Moldova MFA: visa regime for Moldovan citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Moldova
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry table maps the ordinary Moldovan passport to Central African Republic visa treatment.

sources.title: Rwanda DGIE: visa-free destinations for Rwandan passport holders
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration, Rwanda
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Rwanda DGIE ordinary-passport list explicitly includes Central African Republic in its visa-free destination schedule.

policies.title: Foreign CEMAC ordinary passports: Central African Republic visa-free short entry
policies.summary: CEMAC's current Commission material says visa-free movement for Member-State citizens is effective. This directly maps the five other current CEMAC member-state ordinary passports to visa-free entry to the Central African Republic; no current CAR source was found to extend that rule beyond the bloc.
conditions: Applies only to nationals holding ordinary passports of the five other current CEMAC Member States: Cameroon, Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea and Chad.

The CEMAC Common Convention describes tourist movement for up to three months with a valid or recently expired national identity card or passport and an international health booklet. It does not publish a CAR-specific port or fee schedule.

Work, establishment, long-term residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and other special-document arrangements are outside this ordinary short-visitor policy. Passport, health, public-order, security and individual admission controls may still apply.

policies.title: Central African Republic: existing named ordinary-passport advance visas
policies.summary: Current passport-specific government guidance already retained in canonical evidence requires advance visas for these named visitors.
conditions: Carried forward solely for this full-scope candidate. The sources expressly identify ordinary visitor visa requirements before travel or mission processing; no general residual complement is inferred.

policies.title: Rwandan ordinary passport: existing Central African Republic visa-free entry
policies.summary: Rwanda’s current DGIE ordinary-passport schedule expressly records Central African Republic as visa-free.
conditions: Carried forward solely for this full-scope candidate; this named ordinary-passport row is not an inferred regional complement.
